BiblicalUsage: The word names opaqueness, thick darkness, and Jeremiah uses it once, when God asks His people whether He has been a wilderness to Israel, a land of darkness, that they should say they are lords and will come no more to Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the land of darkness is the place God's people imagine when they leave Him, and it is a land He never made for them.
